title: Playboy Video Centerfold: Dalene Kurtis - Playmate of the Year 2002
original_title: Playboy Video Centerfold: Dalene Kurtis - Playmate of the Year 2002
overview: Imagine walking into a Bakersfield, California real estate office and finding the dazzling Dalene Kurtis behind the desk. Lucky for us, Dalene broke free from her workaday life to dazzle our readers with her knock-out form and heart-stopping beauty as Miss September 2001. Since then she's been on the last track to realizing her dreams, and now she's our choice for Playmate of the Year 2002. Join us as we uncover the subtle sensuality and sultry allure that won our hearts in this series of tempting scenarios, Ride along as Dalene shows her stars and stripes to a firehouse of adoring firemen. Then she gets to the church on time but seems to have forgotten her wedding dress. It's revealing romps, tantalizing trysts and flirty fun in Dalene's sexiest videography yet. One look and you'll fall madly in love just as we have.
